info.name: Course Management System — Reproducible API Tests
info.description: Run all 24 requests in their saved order using a current Postman Collection Runner. The original 23 API operations plus one explicit duplicate-view check are included. This workflow performs real writes against the configured local backend, which may use a remote Supabase database. Use only an authorized development environment. It creates unique temporary records, stores ownership IDs in run-local variables only, and deletes only those captured records, children first. Never enter existing record IDs. Individual dependent requests are skipped without current-run ownership. Interrupted runs or unconfirmed creation responses may leave temporary records; there is no broad fallback cleanup. No credentials are required by the current API.
